name: Dubby drums
says: A drum kit with a faulted address line and a cut bus, through a long echo, under a chip on a bent data line.

name: More dubby drum with wandering synth
says: The kit swung at 162 bpm with its trigger lines crossed, an FM voice on a faulted address line, and three feedback loops.

name: Glitch voice
says: The FM chip struck by the kit through the trigger patch, into a sampler loop that keeps recording over itself.

name: Aimless stalling lullaby
says: A demo song on a flat battery with its clock jittering, a crushed kit, crackle and tape hiss.
